data.name: Narayn
data.long_meaning: The name Narayan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nara' meaning man and 'Ayan' meaning protector or rest. It is believed that the name signifies the supreme god Vishnu who is the protector and sustainer of the universe. This name is also associated with the belief that the divine power resides within each individual, providing them with strength and guidance.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for the supreme deity Vishnu, meaning the one who protects and sustains all of creation. It is a reminder of the divine presence within each of us, providing strength, guidance, and protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name Narayan holds immense significance in Hindu culture, especially for those who follow Vaishnavism, a prominent branch of Hinduism. Narayan is often depicted as a form of Lord Vishnu, reclining on the serpent Ananta in the cosmic ocean, preserving the universe. The name is chanted in religious ceremonies, mantras, and hymns, reflecting the deep reverence and devotion for the god. It is also a popular name amongst Hindus and is often given to newborn babies as a sign of divine blessings and protection.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Narayan represents the divine entity, believed to protect and guide individuals on their spiritual journey. It signifies the presence of the supreme being, who is the source of all creation, consciousness, and love. The name is a reminder of the inner divine, invoking feelings of humility, wonder, and awe. It also instills a sense of hope and assurance, as one believes that the protective entity is always present.
